stages: boundary replay and stronger field control
legacy and candidate bridge plus R60 domain extension
three-grid order and frozen prediction assessment

boundary.independent_check: separate signed flux at inner sphere R=12.5 in doubled domain, computed from Phi,Pi and metric; direct numerical outer face flux from actual RHS face values, not previous extrapolation or mass difference; analytic flat flux benchmark; no independent conservative mass evolution scheme claimed
boundary.scope: two weak/stronger subcritical amplitudes; no universal strong-field BC claim

temporal.interpretation: For each peak scalar and each full-trace L2/Linf difference, temporal change must be <1% of refined norm and <=25% of corresponding 12288-to-24576 spatial difference on the identical common proper-time support. This checks temporal contamination at medium grid, not a temporal convergence order or proof at finest grid.

budget.projected_fine_seconds: 4 times measured candidate medium wall time
budget.reason: reserve 10 min for artifacts, conservative O(n^2) projection; if hold, no retry with changed thresholds

three_grid.interpretation: p=log2(d12/d23) for each observable and norm, finite triplet consistency only, no averaging, no theorem of asymptotic convergence. Zero/nonfinite difference yields unidentifiable order. Second-order consistency separate from decreasing-difference gate and forecast gate.

forecast_policy: use exact frozen values and tolerances from forecast_precommit.json without change; absolute and relative errors reported; mismatch remains a scientific result
